summary.text: Kevin Winter is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Rutland-Windsor District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has a background in corporate manufacturing.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Winter was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree from Alfred University.
His career experience includes working in corporate manufacturing.
Winter assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
